title: Test Strategy Input
description: Input contract for the test-strategy agent that enables Python orchestration to pass specific target files and receive structured output.

mode.description: The operation mode for the test-strategy agent. 'generate' creates a new strategy, 'review' validates a proposed plan against a strategy, 'revise' updates a strategy based on coverage gaps.

target_files.description: List of source files that require test strategy planning.

context.description: Additional context to inform strategy generation.

analysis_description.description: Human-readable description of the changes or analysis context.

git_diff.description: Git diff output showing the changes to the target files.

existing_tests.description: Paths to existing test files that cover the target files.

strategy_document.description: The original strategy document being reviewed. Required when mode is 'review'.

proposed_plan.description: The plan to review against the strategy. Required when mode is 'review'.

coverage_gaps.description: List of functions with insufficient coverage. Required when mode is 'revise'.

FileEntry.description: Represents a single source file with optional change metadata.

path.description: Relative path to the source file from the repository root.

functions_changed.description: List of function/method names that were modified. Only applicable when change_type is 'MODIFY'.

ChangeType.description: The type of change made to a file. NEW: new file created (full test coverage required), MODIFY: existing file changed (test additions/updates for changed functions), DELETE: file removed (remove corresponding tests, check for broken refs), RENAME: file renamed (update test imports, verify no logic changes).

CoverageGap.description: Represents a function with insufficient test coverage.

function.description: The name of the function with coverage gaps.

file.description: The file path containing the function.

line_coverage.description: Current line coverage percentage for the function.

branch_coverage.description: Current branch coverage percentage for the function.
